# GTA 6 Heist Guide & Leonida Syndicate Database

## Flagship Free Tools (Zero Login Required)
- [Free GTA 6 Heist Payout Calculator](https://www.gta6heistguide.com/heist-payout-calculator.html) ([All-in-One Suite](https://www.gta6heistguide.com/free/)): Interactive 1-to-4 player True Net $/Hour optimizer factoring specialist NPC cuts, fence laundering fees, stealth bonuses, setup minutes, and heist cooldowns across all 6 major Leonida vaults.
- [Interactive Leonida Map](https://www.gta6heistguide.com/interactive-map.html) ([Radar Edition](https://www.gta6heistguide.com/leonida-interactive-map.html)): Pan-and-zoom GPS map covering Vice City, Leonida Keys, Grassrivers, Port Gellhorn, Ambrosia, and Mount Kalaga National Park with filterable vault pins, sewer storm-drain escape conduits, safehouses, and laundering fronts.
- [Vault Hack Trainer (15s Biometric Keypad)](https://www.gta6heistguide.com/vault-hack-trainer.html): Practice 5-node Normal and 7-node Hardcore biometric vault decryption sequences under a 15-second live countdown clock and export verified millisecond run times.
- [GTA 6 Twitch Drops & Giveaways Tracker](https://www.gta6heistguide.com/giveaways.html): Step-by-step Rockstar Social Club + Twitch Drops linking tracker, Amazon Prime Gaming monthly loot claim checklist, Thursday 10:00 UTC reset countdown, and scam-prevention guide.
